# Nova Football project guidance

- This is an original Godot 4.x 3D football prototype. Do not copy eFootball/Konami branding, assets, teams, or UI.
- Use GDScript and Godot-native scenes/resources. Keep the project runnable without external downloads.
- Keep gameplay code split into focused scripts for match/world, player, ball, camera, and HUD.
- Preserve keyboard controls and document behavior changes in README.md.
- Validate edits with Godot headless editor import/check when the Godot executable is available.
